fix(export-html): blink holds still for a reader who asked for reduced motion (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0hj)

HTML_FRAGMENT_CSS redefines the rich-blink keyframes as empty under
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The blink is an inline animation that no
stylesheet rule outranks, so emptying the keyframes it names is the one lever
the page has. Covers the docs outputs and every encodeHtml document.
